messages.subject: Unable to Specify Interaction with Latent variable
parts:

Here is my model:


Here is my code:

messages.subject: Re: Unable to Specify Interaction with Latent variable
parts: I've been trying to specify an interaction with a latent variable (TrainingChange with AQscore) but have been unable to do so.
That's because TrainingChange is a latent variable.  lavaan does not have this capability (Mplus allows latent interactions using LMS estimation).
Specifically when I identify the interaction in the model figure is DeltaT*AQ.

TransferChange ~ TrainChange*AQscore



This does not specify an interaction.  It tells lavaan to regress TransferChange on AQscore, and to label that slope "TrainChange".  See about Parameter Labels in the tutorial:

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax2.html

An experimental feature of lavaan's model syntax is to allow interactions to be specified using the ":" operator, just like in formula objects (e.g., TransferChange ~ TrainChange + AQscore + TrainChange:AQscore).  But that only works with observed variables.
